description: Estimate what one hour of IT downtime costs a business, from team size, average salary, and annual revenue. Returns the hourly cost broken into idle wages, lost revenue, and recovery, plus the yearly downtime cost at three levels of IT management (well-managed ~8 hours/year, typical SMB ~24 hours/year, unmanaged ~87 hours/year). Same math as the Wizcom Downtime Cost Calculator (https://wizcomltd.com/tools/downtime-calculator). Estimate only.

revenue.description: Annual revenue of the business, in US dollars.

salary.description: Average annual salary per employee, in US dollars.

team.description: Number of employees who stop working when systems are down.
